sentences.text: Oral Order 04 / Dated : 21.07.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The petitioner named above has been made accused in connection with Namkum P.S. Case No. 334 of 2022 (S.T. No. 49 of 2023) for the offence under Sections 304B, 498A, 323, 504, 34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of AJC-XXI, Ranchi.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is the father-in-law of the deceased and the allegation is directed against the husband of the deceased that he had altercation with his wife (deceased) on the night of incidence.
No overt act has been attributed to him and he has been roped in this case only on the allegation that there was dowry demand of Rs. 10 Lakh and Car.
The demand is also against the husband of the deceased.
It is alleged that the petitioner had absconded after the incidence before arrival of the police party.

Learned counsel for the State, assisted by learned counsel for the informant, has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the petitioner was also complicit in the said offence as he was present in the house when the incidence took place.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two Vishnudev Prasad vs The State Of Jharkhand ... .... Opp
